id.description: Join key for one work, project, or volunteer entry, or a stable id for the cover letter questionnaire. For work, project, and volunteer, must equal that entry's id.

role.description: Which kind of questionnaire this is.

questions.description: Question and answer pairs for this resume entry.

version.description: A version field which follows semver - e.g. `1.0.0`. Regexp is per the recommendation of semver.org
